ctx.x: Papa, I'm afraid of all of them, give him that credit. Go to Emanuel Moneta, he'll school you on the piano. He'll teach you your proper fingers. And if he wants to sit there and maybe age has got him a little bit down, but he knows all his, he's going to give you the proper execution for fingers. He can get around. See, what Duke Ellington put in his book there were no reading. What are you going to do with Tony Jackson? My God Almighty. What are you going to do with Michael, who's older than these fellas? Oh…

What are you going to do about Murray down there in Jacksonville, Florida? All those fellas who read. You see, Dr. Locke wrote a book like that too. Oh yeah, I've read that. Yeah, and I could kick him all in the pants around some place for writing that kind of thing about there were no Negro musicians, no Negro bands of consequences. He didn't know. No. So he ought to devote himself to his time to the subject he teaches in Howard and leave this part up to somebody who knows. He was a little bit of a piece of…
